mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.2% compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, increasing present value of future earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate decline below 5.0% signals tightening labor market conditions, increasing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE falls below 5.0%, S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 45% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential construction (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust aggregate demand, driving corporate revenue expansion and positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint growth of HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below 105.0 (INDPRO < 105.0) signals manufacturing slowdowns, reducing corporate capacity utilization and near-term earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO falls below 105.0, S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Nonfarm payrolls growth exceeding 100,000 monthly adds (PAYEMS > 100,000) indicates sustained job market strength, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of months when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100,000.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL monthly change exceeding 0.2% signals accelerating inflation, prompting Federal Reserve tightening that reduces equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL monthly change exceeds 0.2%, S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in unemployment (UNRATE) and increases in payrolls (PAYEMS) indicate labor market tightness, boosting consumer confidence and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in UNRATE and rise in PAYEMS fails to predict positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales growth exceeding 0.5% monthly (RSAFS growth > 0.5%) signals robust consumer demand, supporting corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS growth exceeds 0.5% monthly, S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 45% of cases.
